_note: v4-avail = v1-blend, then a logit shift of points_to_logit per point of spread each team has lost to unavailable players and recent coaching changes (see src/model/v4.ts). Every number here is a prior, not a fit: no history of availability reports exists to fit on. Scale check: a lead back with 45% of rushing yards = 1.35 pts; a WR1 with 30% of receiving yards = 1.2; a defender with 12% of defensive impact = 1.0; a starting QB = 6, fading 25% per straight week already missed. Coordinator changes are tracked and shown but weighted 0 until there is evidence. Any change after v4 rows exist is a new model_version (v4.1-avail).
